name: Krystilia
notes: All tasks must be completed within the Wilderness.
Has no combat or Slayer level requirement and ignores the player's combat level, so she can assign monsters of any level.
Task monsters can drop Larran's keys (rate scales with monster combat level) for Larran's small or big chest.
The free 'I Wildy More Slayer' reward toggle controls whether she can assign jellies, dust devils, nechryael, and abyssal demons; toggling it off removes only those four tasks from her list.

Assignments run a separate task-completion counter from standard masters: the first four completions on that counter award no points, and resetting one of those early assignments restarts the counter.
Cannot assign a new task while the player holds an incomplete task from a standard master.
Highest points per task of any master, at the cost of the separate Wilderness streak.
Found by the jailhouse in Edgeville, north-east of the bank.
